findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. The shared person-name table created at line 254 is reassigned to parsed task rows at line 596. On a normal story with a part, the parent can resolve an approver's email to their latest display name, while the part resolves that same approval record through the replacement table and shows an older name. This breaks the required one-display-name rule; the existing approval-history test has no part row to catch it.
